title.narrative: Conservation of the ecosystems of the Morro de Monte Cristi National Park by strengthening its.management, including community members and fishermen, and the promotion of ecotourism

description.narrative: This project supports conservation efforts in El Morro de Montecristi National Park by strengthening the monitoring and patrolling skills of park rangers via hands-on training and by empowering coastal communities to become stewards of the natural resources they depend on. This project is aimed at conserving dry forests, mangroves, coral reefs and the species that depend upon them from illegal logging, unsustainable agriculture, detrimental fishing and touristic practices, and pollution run off. Proposed project activities include: 1) Training workshops for park rangers in protected area management, environmental legislation, use of GPS equipment, ecosystem services, etc.; 2) Developing a patrolling protocol in consultation with park staff and community representatives aimed at reducing the poaching of endangered species, illegal logging, forest fires and unsustainable fishing practices; 3) Training in the operation of a drone to be used in coastal patrols and species monitoring; 4) Purchasing of basic monitoring and patrolling equipment for park rangers; 5) An environmental and outreach education program for at least 700 local community members; 6) Designing and building an interpretative trail for visitors; 7) Delivering an environmental interpretation course for local guides; and 8) Organizing meetings with two local fishermen associations on sustainable fishing and fisheries management.
